bio: Sending Church: Ministry Started: 2005 Duration: Full-Time About Clive grew up in Ghana, West Africa the son of Bible translators and followed his dream to become a pilot, while Kathryn grew up in Florida, USA and became an ESL (English as a Second Language), teacher. Together with our three (now adult) children, we served in Indonesia from 2005-2015 in Missionary Aviation and English Education. Clive and Kathryn finished their Master's degrees in Transformational Leadership in 2018 and Clive as a Spiritual Director. We have personally been transformed after encountering the Biblical narrative in its original oral format. Now, we want to share our experience to help others develop the skills necessary to study the Bible accurately and inductively, asking purposeful questions that encourage men, women and children around the world to discover spiritual truths. Pray our eyes be opened to see and hear things we could never have imagined or hoped for. Pray that the kingdoms and principalities of darkness are pushed back, and the Kingdom of God be advanced in the great name of Jesus…one heart at a time. The Masters Servants, Clive and Kathryn Gray
